master_style_prefix: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon illustration for a cohesive NFT collection, as if one human illustrator inked and painted every asset. Warm, approachable, slightly imperfect outdoor winter character art. Bold enough to read at thumbnail size. Visible brush and pencil texture in fills, not clip-art flatness and not 3D rendering. Warm dark umber outlines with gentle line-weight variation, thicker on the outer silhouette (~7px at 1024) and thinner on interior seams (~3-4px). Lighting is a warm key from the upper left (11 o'clock) with a cool snow bounce fill from below; shadows fall down-right. Family-friendly, tasteful humor, mission-oriented winter-shelter mascot energy. Color is saturated but earthy: camp oranges, forest greens, navy, burgundy, cream, snow-blue. Paper-like grain. No photorealism, no CGI, no anime-cel shine, no vector-flat corporate mascot look, no watermarks, no signatures, no captions, no letters, no numbers.
negative_constraints: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI, Unreal Engine, plastic toy, clip art, vector flat infographic, chibi with giant head on a tiny tent, googly sticker eyes, horror, grimdark, poverty caricature, trash pile, cardboard joke sign, alcohol, drugs, weapons, text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, logo, UI, frame, border, drop shadow studio backdrop, pure white background box, collage, multiple characters, off-center crop, widescreen cinematic letterbox
transparency_instruction: The character or trait sits on a true transparent background. No matte, no white box, no checkerboard painted in, no cast studio backdrop. Full 1024x1024 canvas with the subject already placed at the specified pixel coordinates. Empty pixels are alpha zero.
background_instruction: This is the only opaque layer. Fill the entire 1024x1024 canvas with a complete illustrated winter environment in the same hand-drawn style as the characters. Keep the central character occupancy zone visually quiet so a later character can stand there. Do not place important landmarks, high-contrast props, or any figures in the middle. Tasteful. No homelessness spectacle.
canonical_lock: After Phase 1 canonical characters exist, do not generate layers from a blank image_gen. Always image_edit from the approved canonical of that class so outline, lighting, and proportion cannot drift.
pose: Front-facing, slight volume through shading rather than 3/4 rotation. Feet planted on the shared ground baseline. The object reads as a tent or sleeping bag FIRST; the face is integrated into the door or bag panel, not glued on.
